# Anchorless
[color=#999999][italic]"THAT'S NOT BENNINGS!"[/italic][/color]
The Anchorless are a formless horror from the clouds of [bold]Jupiter[/bold]. Originally taking the form of single-celled organisms, they can merge together and develop a demented, predatory intelligence. With the arrival of humans, exactly this has happened. The goal of the Anchorless is to assimilate the crew of the station.
Anyone besides [textlink="department heads" link="Command"] or members of [textlink="Security" link="Security"] can be an original Anchorless at the start of the shift.
## Conversion
A single Anchorless is not much. To convert another into your kin, you can click a crit or dead person with the convert action. This is loud and takes a lot of time, so you should ideally find a private place to do it. How you bring this person into the dead or crit state is [italic]up to you[/italic].
## Cooperation
Now that there are more of you, cooperation is on the table. You have two primary tools for this: [color=#b04eb5]a private radio channel[/color] you can access using [bold].a or :a[/bold] and the disguise ability. You can automatically disguise as yourself or anyone you have converted. Additionally, you can [bold]commune[/bold] with your kind to share all of your learned identities.
## Combat
An Anchorless has access to a powerful horror form. This form speeds you up and grants you access to a lethal arm blade, at the cost of giving away the fact that there are anchorless on the station. Unless used strategically, you will suffer more from the jig being up than you will gain with the extra conversion. When you are few, try using [italic]other methods of incapacitation![/italic]
## Weaknesses
The Anchorless are quite vulnerable to [bold]Heat[/bold] damage. Additionally, due to the distributed nature of their bodies, firing weapons overwhelms their senses - flashing them and slowing them down. Anchorless blood is also chemically unstable and [bold]will break down into diethylamine and toxin at 450 kelvin or above.[/bold]
